Someone points you toward a useful resource. A proposal gets a warmer response than expected. A plan finds the missing person, information, or support that lets it move one step further. Nothing has to look enormous yet. The value is that the next step exists now.

Jupiter sextile Jupiter rewards participation more than waiting for certainty. Follow the thread one step further. Take the meeting, read the information, send the follow-up, or make the small investment of time that lets you see what the opening can actually become.
